messages:
fiona: Quick RFC: tighten external export defaults to 7d for SIEM snapshots handed to third parties. Goal: shrink exposure window + simplify lifecycle. Need RBAC gating, KMS unwrap proxy, DLP gating, and legal hold exceptions. @marc @elliot please weigh in.
marc: 7d is aggressive but ok if extension path is simple and auditable. Suggest max auto-extension 30d with approver audit. For anything >30d require legal review.
elliot: RBAC idea: roles `export.request`, `export.approve`, `export.execute`. Requester can open requests, approver can set approved=true, execute role (service account) can call unwrap. Runner service must assume a short-lived role taggable with request_id.
legal-claire: Legal: baseline 7d acceptable for routine partner handoffs. MUST support legal_hold which preserves data until explicit release and records approver IDs + timestamps. Under legal_hold, automatic unwraps are blocked.
fiona: KMS design sketch: approver flips `approved=true` on request record. Runner calls UnwrapProxy with request_id. Proxy verifies approved && legal_hold==false then calls KMS:Decrypt with EncryptionContext.request_id. Proxy returns ephemeral unwrap token (TTL=8m) to runner. All decrypts logged to CloudTrail and mirrored to SIEM with event `export.unseal`.
marc: CMK condition ideas: require kms:EncryptionContext:request_id and a tag `export=siem` in request. Deny Decrypt if request.legal_hold == "true". Enforce via CMK policy.
elliot: Add DLP gating: request form has `contains_sensitive` and `data_class` (PII/Auth/Payment/Other). If contains_sensitive=true, pipeline runs DLP and writes to quarantined bucket path; approver must re-approve after DLP pass.
fiona: Request schema draft below. please comment.
```
request_id: auto
requester: name/email
scope: index pattern + time range
justification: free text
retention_days: default 7 (max 365 if approved; >30 requires legal)
contains_sensitive: checkbox
data_class: enum
legal_hold: boolean
approver: id
executor: service account id
audit_links: ticket/slack
```
marc: CLI stubs:
```bash
# create request
rw logs export request --scope "auth-logs:2026-03-15..2026-03-16" \\  --retention 7 --justification "third-party triage" --requester fiona@redwood.ai
# approve
rw logs export approve --id REQ-2026-1515 --approver marc@redwood.ai
```
legal-claire: For legal_hold releases require two approvers (legal + security) and record immutable audit. No automated expiry while in legal_hold. Add required `legal_contact` when contains_sensitive=true.
elliot: Auditing: ensure every state change emits an event: request.created, request.approved, export.unseal, export.uploaded, export.deleted. Correlate KMS kms:RequestId with request_id in SIEM. Provide CloudTrail query snippet in PR.
